title: Supermicro Stock Jumps 10% on Doubled Margins and Record AI Backlog
excerpt: Supermicro stock jumped 9% after Q4 margins nearly doubled and fiscal 2027 guidance reached $72 billion. Key numbers inside.
content_html:
Supermicro stock (SMCI) jumped nearly 10% in after market trading on Tuesday. It follows Super Micro Computer posting a 17.5% quarterly gross margin, almost double last year, and a record order backlog.

Less than two years ago, the AI server maker was fighting to keep its Nasdaq listing. Now it projects up to $72 billion in annual sales.

Supermicro reported results after Tuesday's close. Net sales reached $11.1 billion for the quarter ended June 30, nearly double the $5.8 billion a year earlier.

Yet the margin move stole the show. Gross margin hit 17.5%, up from 9.9% just three months earlier. Net income climbed six-fold to $1.18 billion.

Adjusted earnings, which exclude stock-based pay, hit $1.70 per share. That was two and a half times the 68-cent consensus tracked by Zacks. Revenue, meanwhile, landed at the low end of the company's own $11 billion to $12.5 billion target.

Thin margins had long been Supermicro's weak spot. Big cloud customers squeezed prices, and rivals fought hard for every AI server deal. Tuesday's numbers also push back on fears that AI spending is slowing.

"As demand accelerates, we are improving profitability through a richer enterprise customer mix and broader adoption of our optimized Data Center Building Block Solutions® (DCBBS) architecture," founder and CEO Charles Liang explained the improvement in the earnings statement.

Follow us on X to get the latest news as it happens

Record Backlog Sets Up a $72 Billion Year

Supermicro expects $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion in September-quarter revenue, over 30% above the June quarter. Full fiscal 2027 sales should land between $65 billion and $72 billion. The top end sits 84% above fiscal 2026's $39.1 billion.

Liang said the company booked over $60 billion in new orders and added several hundred enterprise customers in a year. A July preliminary update flagged the order surge and sent the stock up more than 20% in one day.

The order wave matches heavy spending across AI hardware, where Nvidia's $500 billion deal has raised demand-quality questions.

The rally extends one of the sharpest comebacks in AI hardware. Short seller Hindenburg Research accused the company of accounting manipulation in August 2024. Auditor Ernst & Young then resigned, and the shares lost roughly a third of their value in a day.

Supermicro filed its delayed reports in February 2025 and kept its Nasdaq listing.

That history still shadows the numbers. The results are preliminary and unaudited, and the board is reviewing certain transactions tied to export controls. Inventories nearly tripled to $12.9 billion, and operations consumed $6.8 billion in cash for the year.

The rally now rests on one question. Can margins near 17% survive as that backlog turns into shipped systems? The September quarter will offer the first answer.

content_html_zh:
Supermicro 股票 (SMCI) 在周二盘后交易中上涨近 10%。 在此之前，超微电脑公布了 17.5% 的季度毛利率，几乎是去年的两倍，并且订单积压创历史新高。

不到两年前，这家人工智能服务器制造商正在努力保住纳斯达克上市地位。 现在它预计年销售额将达到 720 亿美元。

周二收盘后，超微公布了业绩。 截至 6 月 30 日的季度净销售额达到 111 亿美元，几乎是去年同期 58 亿美元的两倍。

然而利润率的变动却抢尽了风头。 毛利率从三个月前的 9.9% 升至 17.5%。 净利润增长六倍，达到 11.8 亿美元。

调整后收益（不包括基于股票的薪酬）达到每股 1.70 美元。 这是 Zacks 追踪的 68 美分共识的两倍半。 与此同时，收入落在公司 110 亿至 125 亿美元目标的低端。

利润微薄长期以来一直是超微的弱点。 大云客户压榨价格，竞争对手为每一笔人工智能服务器交易而苦苦挣扎。 周二的数据也打消了人们对人工智能支出放缓的担忧。

“随着需求的加速，我们正在通过更丰富的企业客户组合和更广泛地采用我们优化的数据中心构建模块解决方案® (DCBBS) 架构来提高盈利能力，”创始人兼首席执行官梁见后 (Charles Liang) 在收益报表中解释了这一改善。

在 X 上关注我们以获取最新消息

年度积压订单创纪录，价值 720 亿美元

Supermicro 预计 9 月份季度收入为 145 亿至 155 亿美元，比 6 月份季度增长 30% 以上。 2027 财年的全部销售额应在 650 亿美元至 720 亿美元之间。 高端收入比 2026 财年的 391 亿美元高出 84%。

梁表示，该公司一年内新增订单超过 600 亿美元，新增数百家企业客户。 7 月份的初步更新显示订单激增，导致该股一日内上涨 20% 以上。

订单浪潮与人工智能硬件领域的巨额支出相匹配，Nvidia 的 5000 亿美元交易引发了需求质量问题。

此次涨势延续了人工智能硬件领域最强劲的反弹之一。 卖空者兴登堡研究公司 (Hindenburg Research) 于 2024 年 8 月指控该公司存在会计操纵行为。 审计师安永会计师事务所随后辞职，股价一天之内损失了大约三分之一。

Supermicro 于 2025 年 2 月提交了延迟报告，并保留了在纳斯达克的上市地位。

这段历史仍然给数字带来阴影。 结果是初步且未经审计的，董事会正在审查与出口管制相关的某些交易。 库存增加近两倍，达到 129 亿美元，全年运营消耗现金 68 亿美元。

现在的集会集中在一个问题上。 当积压的订单变成已发货的系统时，接近 17% 的利润率还能维持下去吗？ 九月季度将给出第一个答案。
